verdict.rationale: Riveter documents its own scrape capability in the API and Go SDK. That capability turns a URL into 'easily parseable text', which is not raw HTML, and the docs never say a scrape is a single synchronous call. missing for 10: documented raw HTML output, explicit single-request/synchronous scrape semantics, response format details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scrape a web page with a single API call and get its raw HTML back

citations.quote: A scrape lets you turn a URL into easily parseable text.
The Riveter API lets you enrich data, build datasets, scrape webpages, quickly search the web, and extract data from complicated websites programmatically.
Official Go SDK for the Riveter API — enrich data, build datasets, scrape pages, and run web searches.
